headline: As of 2026-10-08: 2,377,292 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 33 of 50 states, D+27.7 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 2,377,292 early/mail ballots cast so far across 33 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+27.7 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (448,949), Florida (425,026), Michigan (297,071).
